dialogue_texts: How did my parameters... collapse? Did someone force my way through spatial anomaly?
Their raw power defies the math.
Heh, told ya! Magic isn't about perfectly balanced equations...
It's about who can pack the biggest punch!
The glohm was using your own magical channels to anchor the distortion.
My coordinates should be stable now, thanks to your blunt-force intervention.
But be warned - the glohm's core at the Shirogane Manor is fully active.
What you fought just now is merely a localized spillover.
A localized spillover, and it was that strong?
Man, the core inside the manor must be an absolute goldmine of magic.
Come on, Shirogane-sama, we gotta get in there before the Order steals all the good stuff!
